properties.name_zh: 主脊沿线存量概念建筑基底
properties.usage_note: Conceptual footprint only; not an existing-building survey, ownership conclusion, or approved development envelope.
properties.accountable_role_zh: 规划管控与建筑测量专业人员（未来经授权）
properties.rollback_state_zh: 本要素为概念对象（`official_boundary=false`、`evidence_status=concept_only`），不含任何已安装构件；撤回或替换只发生在文件层，不产生现场撤除动作。官方几何到位时整体替换，并按 EPSG:4548 重新复算全部关联读数。本要素登记的是存量概念占地，按「保留优先核验」策略不提出任何新建或改造动作。
properties.rollback_state_en: A conceptual object (`official_boundary=false`, `evidence_status=concept_only`) carrying no installed component; withdrawal or replacement happens at file level and triggers no removal on site. When official geometry arrives the feature is replaced whole and every dependent reading recomputed in EPSG:4548. The feature registers an existing-stock conceptual footprint and, under the verify-retention-first strategy, proposes no new construction or adaptation.
properties.next_review_trigger_zh: 取得经清权的官方现状建筑测量或用地边界，或 R-05 政策不确定性停止阈值成立（适用许可、官方资料、专业责任或开放边界缺失且现有证据不足以支持下一闸门）时立即复审。
properties.next_review_trigger_en: Reviewed as soon as a cleared official existing-building survey or land boundary arrives, or R-05 policy uncertainty triggers — applicable permission, official material, professional accountability, or the opening boundary missing, with existing evidence insufficient for the next gate.

properties.name_zh: 众智园通用接口实验院受控测试庭概念体量
properties.name_en: Universal Interface Lab Controlled Test Court Concept Massing
properties.design_role_zh: JZ-02 通用接口实验院概念体量包络，用于表达受控测试庭、验证前厅与状态信号的空间量级。
properties.usage_note: Conceptual footprint only; not an existing-building survey, ownership conclusion, or approved development envelope.
properties.accountable_role_zh: 城市设计、技术安全与场地管理人员（未来经授权）
properties.accountable_role_en: Urban design, technology-safety, and site-management personnel (future, authorised)
properties.rollback_state_zh: 本要素为概念对象（`official_boundary=false`、`evidence_status=concept_only`），不含任何已安装构件；撤回或替换只发生在文件层，不产生现场撤除动作。官方几何到位时整体替换，并按 EPSG:4548 重新复算全部关联读数。受控测试庭与验证前厅的概念体量包络，其设计动作最早可在 G2 封闭成对测试闸门被验收——未成熟技术不得在此前进入开放空间。
properties.rollback_state_en: A conceptual object (`official_boundary=false`, `evidence_status=concept_only`) carrying no installed component; withdrawal or replacement happens at file level and triggers no removal on site. When official geometry arrives the feature is replaced whole and every dependent reading recomputed in EPSG:4548. A concept massing envelope for the controlled test court and validation forecourt, whose design action can first be accepted at the G2 closed paired-test gate — immature technology may not reach open space before then.
properties.next_review_trigger_zh: JZ-02 停止条件任一成立（精确范围、安全边界或人工接管未闭合）时立即复审；进入 L4b 有期限常态运行后，按 R-11 到期未复审规则在 `review_due` 到期前完成三方复核；运行声明的 `as_of_date` 晚于 `review_due` 即立即按 L0 对待。
properties.next_review_trigger_en: Reviewed immediately when any JZ-02 stop condition holds (exact scope, safety boundary, or human handover unresolved); Once at L4b time-bounded routine operation, the three-way review must be completed before `review_due` under R-11; an operating declaration whose `as_of_date` passes `review_due` is treated immediately as L0.

properties.name_en: Independent Living Co-design Lab Concept Massing
properties.design_role_zh: JZ-03 独立生活共创院概念体量包络，用于表达共创室、安静线与易读服务前厅的空间量级。
properties.usage_note: Conceptual footprint only; not an existing-building survey, ownership conclusion, or approved development envelope.
properties.accountable_role_zh: 共同设计主持人、数据治理与参与者代表（未来经授权）
properties.accountable_role_en: Co-design facilitators, data governance, and participant representatives (future, authorised)
properties.rollback_state_zh: 本要素为概念对象（`official_boundary=false`、`evidence_status=concept_only`），不含任何已安装构件；撤回或替换只发生在文件层，不产生现场撤除动作。官方几何到位时整体替换，并按 EPSG:4548 重新复算全部关联读数。共创室、安静线与易读服务前厅的概念体量包络，其设计动作涉及真实参与者，最早可在 G2 封闭成对测试闸门被验收。
properties.rollback_state_en: A conceptual object (`official_boundary=false`, `evidence_status=concept_only`) carrying no installed component; withdrawal or replacement happens at file level and triggers no removal on site. When official geometry arrives the feature is replaced whole and every dependent reading recomputed in EPSG:4548. A concept massing envelope for the co-design rooms, quiet line and easy-read service forecourt; because its design action involves real participants it can first be accepted at the G2 closed paired-test gate.
properties.next_review_trigger_zh: JZ-03 停止条件任一成立（招募失衡、同意不可撤回或便利不足）时立即复审；进入 L4b 有期限常态运行后，按 R-11 到期未复审规则在 `review_due` 到期前完成三方复核；运行声明的 `as_of_date` 晚于 `review_due` 即立即按 L0 对待。
properties.next_review_trigger_en: Reviewed immediately when any JZ-03 stop condition holds (unbalanced recruitment, consent that cannot be withdrawn, or missing accommodation); Once at L4b time-bounded routine operation, the three-way review must be completed before `review_due` under R-11; an operating declaration whose `as_of_date` passes `review_due` is treated immediately as L0.

properties.rollback_state_zh: 本要素为概念对象（`official_boundary=false`、`evidence_status=concept_only`），不含任何已安装构件；撤回或替换只发生在文件层，不产生现场撤除动作。官方几何到位时整体替换，并按 EPSG:4548 重新复算全部关联读数。多通道商业前厅、支付替代与维护退出台的概念体量包络，面向公众开放，未通过 G3 独立复核闸门不进入开放空间。
